title: tshark: Add -E split=<proto> option for per-message-instance field output
description:
Add a new "split" option to -T fields output that produces one CSV row per message instance of the specified protocol within a packet. This is useful when a single packet contains multiple protocol messages (e.g., several Diameter messages bundled in one SCTP packet).

Fields belonging to a specific message instance are output only on that instance's row, while fields not under any instance (e.g., frame-level fields) are repeated on every row.

Usage: 

```
tshark -T fields -e frame.number -e diameter.cmd.code -E split=diameter
```

Fix #21063

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)
